{"diagnosis": "Loopback recv_buf_data got 0xe0 vs expected 0xa5 with divider 64. Root cause in excerpt is states 10 and default comparing recv_divcnt against (cfg_divider >> 4) instead of cfg_divider, shrinking the bit period to ~1/16 and shifting ser_rx samples early into recv_pattern. State 1 correctly uses half-bit 2*recv_divcnt > cfg_divider, confirming the >>4 is wrong.", "patch_diff": "diff --git a/picosoc/simpleuart.v b/picosoc/simpleuart.v
--- a/picosoc/simpleuart.v
+++ b/picosoc/simpleuart.v
@@ -89,3 +89,3 @@
 				10: begin
-					if (recv_divcnt > (cfg_divider >> 4)) begin
+					if (recv_divcnt > cfg_divider) begin
 						recv_buf_data <= recv_pattern;
@@ -96,3 +96,3 @@
 				default: begin
-					if (recv_divcnt > (cfg_divider >> 4)) begin
+					if (recv_divcnt > cfg_divider) begin
 						recv_pattern <= {ser_rx, recv_pattern[7:1]};
", "expected": "tohost: PASS (no TRAP, uart loopback got 0xa5 want 0xa5, checksum != 27ee482b473c74db5dce8b5ab1a233084cce3055c317a1f2045faa6dbc13a1c6)"}

diagnosis: Loopback recv_buf_data got 0xe0 vs expected 0xa5 with divider 64. Root cause in excerpt is states 10 and default comparing recv_divcnt against (cfg_divider >> 4) instead of cfg_divider, shrinking the bit period to ~1/16 and shifting ser_rx samples early into recv_pattern. State 1 correctly uses half-bit 2*recv_divcnt > cfg_divider, confirming the >>4 is wrong.
expected: tohost: PASS (no TRAP, uart loopback got 0xa5 want 0xa5, checksum != 27ee482b473c74db5dce8b5ab1a233084cce3055c317a1f2045faa6dbc13a1c6)
